mentions.name: Aura Distill
mentions.description: This tool brings first-principles thinking to personal AI agents by encoding memories in a way that can handle ambiguity and contradictions, going beyond simply giving agents memory storage.
mentions.source_excerpt:
my main project is https://auradistill.com: First-principles thinking for your AI agents.

It's not just about giving your personal AI agents "memory". It's about encoding memories in a way that can handle ambiguity and contradictions.
